hotels.description: Welcome to a secluded private island paradise, where vibrant rainforest meets pristine beaches and emerald waters. Experience an untouched slice of paradise at Pangkor Laut Resort where the villas are designed to harmonise with nature - whether perched atop lush hills, floating gracefully on the Straits of Malacca or nestled within the jungle canopy. Relaxation lies at the heart of the resort, with two stunning pools, a dedicated activities program to help you plan your island explorations and onsite tennis and squash courts. The award-winning Spa Village blends the healing traditions of Malay, Chinese and Indian cultures, offering a sanctuary for complete rejuvenation. Dining here is equally exceptional, with six exquisite restaurants and bars offering diverse, globally inspired cuisine. From personalised Asian dishes at Uncle Lim’s Kitchen to beachfront cocktails at Chapman’s Bar and fresh seafood at Fisherman’s Cove, each venue provides a unique, unforgettable experience.
